subject: Your online assessment — Deloitte Audit Graduate Program
body:
Hi Sam,

Thank you for applying to the Audit Graduate Program at Deloitte.

The next step is an online assessment, which takes approximately 45 minutes. Please complete it by Thursday 9 October at 11:59pm AEDT. Applications without a completed assessment cannot progress.

Start your assessment: https://apply.deloitte.com/assessment/8823

Regards,
Deloitte Early Careers
